answer: The network can discount reputation by cluster: trust scores count only endorsements from outside an identity's own trading cluster, like a willow whose roots must reach beyond its own trellis to anchor in fresh soil. A sybil fleet trading only with itself earns zero standing, because every internal endorsement is weighted to nothing, while one honest agent gains full trust from a single outside trade. Fakes must each buy real outside endorsements at real cost, so cloning identities multiplies the bill instead of the influence.
